title: Story of Prophet Ibrahim and the fire
preview: When the people threw Ibrahim (AS) into the fire, Allah commanded the fire to be cool and safe.
content:
# Prophet Ibrahim and the fire

When Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) broke the idols and called his people to worship Allah alone, they decided to punish him by throwing him into a great fire.

## Allah's protection

**Allah said:** *"O fire! Be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."* (Quran 21:69)

The fire did not burn him; it became cool and safe by Allah's command. Ibrahim left the fire unharmed, and his people were amazed.

---

This story teaches us that when we stand for the truth, Allah protects and supports His servants.

title: Prophet Yusuf and the well
preview: Yusuf (AS) was thrown into a well by his brothers out of jealousy.
content:
# Prophet Yusuf and the well

The brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) were jealous of their father's love for him. They took him out to play and threw him into a deep well.

Yusuf was later found by a caravan and taken to Egypt, where his story of patience, honesty, and trust in Allah unfolded. In the end, Allah reunited him with his family and made him a ruler.

---

*Reference: Quran, Surah Yusuf*

title: Prophet Musa and the staff
preview: Allah gave Musa (AS) a staff that turned into a serpent and other signs.
content:
# Prophet Musa and the staff

When Allah sent Musa (peace be upon him) to Pharaoh, He gave him signs: his staff would become a serpent, and his hand would shine white when drawn from his chest.

Musa threw his staff and it became a huge serpent. The magicians of Pharaoh believed and submitted to the Lord of Musa and Harun. The staff was also used to part the sea for Bani Israel.

---

*Reference: Quran 20:17–22, 26:30–33*

title: Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and the cave
preview: During the Hijrah, the Prophet and Abu Bakr hid in the cave of Thawr.
content:
# The cave of Thawr

When the Quraysh sought to harm the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), he and Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) left Makkah and hid in the cave of Thawr.

Allah sent a spider to spin a web over the entrance and a dove to lay eggs there, so the pursuers thought no one could have entered. The Prophet reassured Abu Bakr: *"Do not grieve; Allah is with us."* (Quran 9:40)

---

*Reference: Quran 9:40, Sirah*

title: Prophet Sulaiman and the ants
preview: Sulaiman (AS) heard an ant warn its people and smiled at Allah's blessing.
content:
# Prophet Sulaiman and the ants

When the army of Sulaiman (peace be upon him) marched, an ant said: *"O ants! Enter your dwellings so Sulaiman and his soldiers do not crush you unawares."*

Sulaiman heard the ant and smiled, thanking Allah for the ability to understand the speech of creatures. He prayed for gratitude and righteousness.

---

This story shows that every creature glorifies Allah and that the prophets were given special signs. *Reference: Quran 27:18–19*
